title: First Dungeons and Dragons game with Bing as the DM went amazing... at first.
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Crossposting this, because bing chat might be more usable for game like scenarios since it has access to the current web. I hope we see more tinkering with this and it doesn't get nerfed into the ground like chatgpt. I'm still optimistic we'll see ways to use LLMs as the "OS" for NPC behaviours in the future.
